relatedPosts.title: Stuck Updating Lambda@Edge using Cross-Region References in AWS CDK
relatedPosts.description: A story about getting stuck updating Lambda@Edge due to Export values between cross-region stacks (us-east-1 and ap-northeast-1) when building an S3 + CloudFront + cognito-at-edge architecture with AWS CDK, and the solution using SSM Parameter Store.

relatedPosts.title: Building a Text Classifier with SVM using Doc2Vec and Optuna
relatedPosts.description: As a practice for using Optuna, I quickly wrote a text classifier using Doc2Vec. The output includes the model's accuracy, F1 score, and a Confusion Matrix using `pyplot`.
